scenario: LRST.6.3 — `as <expr>` (no colon) is the canonical correlation form on `call` actions. The `as: "<lit>"` kwarg form is rejected with DS_VALIDATE_LEGACY_AS_COLON (LRST.1.3). Pin: a `call svc.method ... as t.entity_id` action with the no-colon form compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
service svc.method:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.method entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 30_s as t.entity_id
